Okay, fine. I have the vectors. Now what? How do I get the cosine of the angle?

The angle between two planes is equivalent to the angle between their normal vectors. To find the cosine of the angle $\theta$ between two vectors $\mathbf{n_1}$ and $\mathbf{n_2}$, you can use the dot product formula:

$$\cos \theta = \frac{|\mathbf{n_1} \cdot \mathbf{n_2}|}{\left\| \mathbf{n_1} \right\| \left\| \mathbf{n_2} \right\|}$$

This involves calculating the dot product of the two vectors for the numerator and the product of their magnitudes for the denominator.
